title: SIEM Monitoring & Log Analysis Lab
description: Centralized logging and alert analysis using Wazuh.
summary: Designed and deployed a centralized Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) environment using the Wazuh platform integrated with the Elastic Stack. Multiple Linux systems were configured with Wazuh agents to forward authentication logs, system activity, and security telemetry into a centralized monitoring server. The environment simulates the workflow of a Security Operations Center (SOC) where analysts monitor logs, detect suspicious activity, and investigate security alerts.
results: Built a working centralized log aggregation pipeline
Practiced investigation of security alerts and telemetry

title: Custom Premium Website Product
description: Premium interactive website product built to showcase projects, technical documentation, and polished client-facing presentation.
summary: Designed and developed a premium interactive website product to showcase projects, technical documentation, and proof-driven deliverables through a polished, user-friendly experience. The build uses data-driven project cards, expandable detail panels, responsive layout behavior, and animated visual architecture to transform structured project work into a professional client- and recruiter-ready showcase.
results: Designed and developed a live website product for professional project presentation
Built reusable project card components with expandable detail views
Integrated interactive visual architecture with project navigation
Improved accessibility and presentation of technical project content
Delivered a responsive experience across desktop and mobile devices
Produced a polished client-facing and recruiter-ready digital showcase

title: Vulnerability Management Lab
description: Simulated vulnerability discovery, triage and remediation workflow.
summary: Built a vulnerability management workflow beginning with asset discovery, followed by vulnerability scanning and risk prioritization. Systems were scanned using OpenVAS and results were analyzed to determine which vulnerabilities posed the greatest operational risk. Remediation plans were documented and follow-up scans were performed to confirm vulnerabilities had been mitigated.
results: Performed vulnerability scans across multiple hosts

title: Azure Security Hardening & Monitoring
description: Cloud infrastructure hardened with identity, network and monitoring controls.
summary: Deployed a secure Azure cloud environment and implemented multiple defensive layers including network security groups, identity access control, and monitoring instrumentation. SSH access was restricted to trusted IP ranges and system activity was monitored through centralized logging. The lab demonstrates practical cloud security engineering techniques used to reduce attack surface and improve visibility.
results: Restricted VM access to trusted IP ranges
Reduced attack surface of deployed cloud services

title: Azure Infrastructure Security Lab
description: Deployment of secure Azure infrastructure including networking and VM architecture.
summary: Designed and deployed a cloud infrastructure environment using Microsoft Azure virtual machines and networking services. The project focused on learning how secure cloud infrastructure is architected, including network segmentation, VM configuration, and connectivity testing. The lab demonstrates how modern organizations deploy scalable cloud infrastructure securely.

title: Security Toolchain Environment
description: Integrated cybersecurity tools used for vulnerability analysis and operations.
summary: Built a portable cybersecurity toolchain environment containing commonly used security analysis tools. The toolchain allows vulnerability scanning, system analysis, and operational testing from a single environment. The objective of this lab was to understand how multiple security tools can be combined into a cohesive operational toolkit.

title: Security Operations HUD Interface
description: Custom terminal HUD for controlling security operations and workflows.
summary: Developed a custom terminal interface designed to simplify operational control of cybersecurity tools. The HUD provides a visual command menu that allows the operator to quickly launch security tools and operational workflows. The goal was to create a simplified operator interface similar to those used in professional security operations environments.

title: Portable Cybersecurity Workstation
description: Custom cyberdeck workstation for portable security testing and analysis.
summary: Designed and assembled a portable cybersecurity workstation capable of running multiple security testing environments. The cyberdeck allows security analysis to be performed from a portable platform and demonstrates how professionals may build mobile security labs for testing and training.

title: Encrypted Live Security Environment
description: Portable Linux security environment with encrypted persistence.
summary: Created a secure portable operating system environment using a Linux live USB with encrypted persistence. The system allows security tools and configurations to remain persistent across sessions while protecting stored data through encryption.

title: System Backup & Recovery Lab
description: Automated backup and recovery workflow protecting system configurations.
summary: Designed a system backup workflow to protect critical lab configurations and project environments. Automated backup scripts were used to copy project data and system configurations to external storage devices to prevent data loss.

title: Network Time Synchronization Service
description: Network-based time synchronization ensuring accurate system logging.
summary: Configured network time synchronization across multiple systems to ensure consistent system timestamps. Accurate timestamps are critical for log correlation during security investigations.

title: Security Lab Repository Management System
description: Git-based workflow managing cybersecurity lab documentation and version control.
summary: Designed a version-controlled repository system to track cybersecurity lab development, documentation, and configurations. The repository provides a structured way to maintain project history and reproducibility.
results: Tracked project history through version control
